name: Meeting Assistant Bot
description: AI-powered meeting transcription and summarization bot

settings_schema.header: Configure the Meeting Assistant Bot plugin. You'll need an OpenAI API key to use transcription and summarization features.
settings_schema.footer: For more information, visit the plugin documentation.

settings.help_text: Enter your OpenAI API key. This key is used for Whisper (transcription) and GPT-4o (summarization) APIs. The key should start with 'sk-'.
When enabled, the plugin will log additional debug information. Useful for troubleshooting.
